name: Medication Domain Authority

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: A prescription or clinical signature is executed by an actor without physician authority or without a registered legal professional identity (cédula profesional).
foreseeableSequence: role string trusted from client, or AI/system actor
no professional identity bound to the act
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Unlawful prescription; no accountable prescriber; patient harm without recourse.

controls.name: PRESCRIBE and signature require PHYSICIAN role and registered professional credentials (cédula); identity snapshot persisted in the event

invariants.statement: AI/system cannot promote recommendation to DECIDED/SIGNED clinical authority.
PRESCRIBE and clinical signature require PHYSICIAN authority and registered professional credentials; the legal identity is persisted with the act.

safetyArgument: Authority establishes intended behavior and boundaries.
Controls prevent, detect, correct, or recover from those conditions.
Invariants define conditions that must remain true.
Tests provide executable oracles; execution evidence is separately required.
Capability remains blocked when any required safety-case element is absent.
